finite_pilot_supplement.scope: controlled discrete prior on all 14 legal public 2x2 occupancy patterns, 3x3 material nodes, 5x5 pose nodes; calibrated instrument and known target intrinsic material
finite_pilot_supplement.independent_grid_audit: 12 deterministic state-index quantiles floor(linspace(0,2949,12)), n384/grid3, 48RHS/12FE within E2E3 cap; original0.1 tolerance; not uniform or posterior error certificate

observations.reason: minimal Maxwell compensation test from E1
new source, shared wall and target pose
remaining independent base-aperture channels; no reused observations

finite_pilot_supplement.prior_bank: 2950 full-FEM four-source means shared equally by all methods; actual preparation charged E2E3, standalone attribution retains it

revisitation.ordinary_incremental: exact finite-prior factor update, equal to batch reference
revisitation.hard_freeze: early MAP wall group retained, target conditional updated
revisitation.soft_freeze: preserve early wall marginal and update target conditional; explicitly approximate until REOPEN correction
revisitation.spectral_only: reopen if new marginal wall information increment exceeds 10 percent of prior whitened trace
revisitation.innovation_only: reopen if posterior predictive innovation exceeds predeclared 99 percent Gaussian chi-square reference; heuristic for mixtures
revisitation.task_weighted: local Gaussian omitted-wall task regret plus omitted covariance exceeds tau
revisitation.task_threshold_cost: tau uses the current full finite-reference Bayes risk; its full update CPU is attributed. This reference-dependent diagnostic is not a cheap deployable certificate.
revisitation.ordinary_iterative_point: two finite-prior wall-then-pose coordinate MAP sweeps retaining all factors; explicitly not continuous layer-stripping FWI
revisitation.qualified_reopen: same local rule, plus finite-prior posterior discrepancy audit; auditing cost included and no cost advantage presumed
revisitation.tau: 0.05 times reference target Bayes risk plus 0.005 squared
revisitation.periodic: exact global factor refresh every second new observation; finite table refresh, not FE relinearization
revisitation.factor_refresh: replace version of same factor and apply log-likelihood ratio or rebuild once from base prior

active_sensing.conditional: finite posterior reference valid; no continuous probability claim
active_sensing.local_singular_score: minimum squared singular value of four public-scaled joint parameters; zero if rank<4, before any finite pilot outcomes
active_sensing.angle_retention_equivalence: data-only range-normalized angle sum and retention trace are algebraically equivalent here; they are not distinct novelty evidence
active_sensing.noise: independent action-evaluation noise, never reused to choose action

finite_pilot_supplement.limitations: No newly proved exact nonlinear nonrecoverable world pair is assumed. Missing such negative control remains an explicit E3 qualification gap. No parameter relabeling is used as a physical ambiguity.
